rationale.consistency: Flag names mirror zoekt-git-index and errors are wrapped idiomatically, but the shared indexer now lets any preset Name override zoekt.name/origin-derived names, which changes zoekt-git-index (it presets Name) despite the keep-behaviour constraint; unix-only flock import.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles root-as-repo, bare repos, .git files, symlinked/duplicate roots and name collisions; but no-root case returns an error without printing usage, compound shards abort inventory, and any walk permission error aborts discovery.
rationale.scope: Delivers discovery, preview/apply, list, remove, lock; adds an undocumented 'sync' alias and a DryRun field in gitindex, and the name-precedence change is broader than an opt-in needed for this command.
rationale.readability: Clear small functions and messages; nits: loop var 'path' shadows the path import, duplicated sort closures, 'Indexing'/'Indexed' double output.
rationale.robustness: flock lock with proper cleanup, errors joined, meta removed before shard, dry run returns before any write; but dry run does not lock and the gitindex semantic shift can silently rename repos for existing callers.
rationale.maintainability: repositoryKey duplicates repositorySpec, sorting logic repeated, and prune correctness depends on an implicit Source-normalisation contract between discovery and gitindex metadata.
